function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – What to Look For When it comes to men’s underwear, “best” is a mix of comfort, fit, durability, and style. Below is a quick guide to the most popular styles, what they’re good for, and tips on choosing the right one for you. | Style | Key Features | Ideal Use | Pros | Cons | |-------|--------------|-----------|------|------| | **Boxer Briefs** | Long‑leg, snug fit; elastic waistband | Everyday wear, sports, travel | • Good support
• Keeps everything in place
• Versatile | • Can feel tight for some
• May show through tight shirts | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Short leg, snug fit; waistband at hips | Daily wear, formal settings | • Excellent support
• Minimal bulk | • Less coverage
• Can feel restrictive | | **Boxers** | Loose fit, short or long leg; elastic waistband | Casual, lounging | • Breathable
• Comfortable | • Little support
• Can bunch up | | **Trunks** | Short leg, snug fit; waistband at hips | Athletic, everyday | • Modern look
• Good support | • Less coverage than briefs | | **Jockstrap** | Supportive pouch, minimal fabric | Sports, high‑impact activities | • Excellent support
• Minimal bulk | • Not for everyday wear | | **Compression Shorts** | Tight fit, full coverage | Athletic, post‑workout | • Muscle support
• Reduces chafing | • Can feel restrictive | | **Bamboo/Organic Cotton** | Eco‑friendly fabrics | Sensitive skin, eco‑conscious | • Soft, breathable
• Hypoallergenic | • Can be pricier | | **Performance Tech (e.g., Dri‑Fit, Coolmax)** | Moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor | Hot climates, intense workouts | • Keeps dry
• Odor control | • Usually synthetic | | **Hybrid (e.g., Boxer‑Brief with a loose front)** | Combines coverage and support | Those who want both | • Versatile | • Can be hard to find | --- ## How to Pick the Right One 1. **Consider Your Activity Level** - **Low activity**: Boxers or briefs for comfort. - **High activity**: Compression shorts or jockstrap for support. - **Mixed**: Boxer briefs or trunks. 2. **Think About Fabric** - **Cotton**: Soft, breathable, but can absorb sweat. - **Microfiber / Polyester blends**: Moisture‑wicking, quick‑dry. - **Bamboo / Modal**: Eco‑friendly, naturally antibacterial. - **Spandex / Lycra**: Adds stretch and shape retention. 3. **Fit Matters** - **Waistband**: Should sit comfortably at the hips, not dig into skin. - **Leg length**: Boxers/trunks should not be too long or too short. - **Support**: For active wear, look for a supportive pouch or compression. 4. **Style & Color** - **Neutral colors** (black, navy, gray) are versatile. - **Bold colors or patterns** can add personality but may show through clothing. 5. **Durability & Care** - Check the care label: Some fabrics shrink or lose elasticity if washed improperly. - Look for reinforced stitching at stress points (waistband, crotch). --- ## Top Picks (2024) | Brand | Style | Why It’s Great | |-------|-------|----------------| | **Uniqlo** | Ultra Stretch Briefs | Affordable, breathable, great fit. | | **Calvin Klein** | Modern Trunks | Classic design, premium cotton. | | **Under Armour** | Tech Compression Shorts | Moisture‑wicking, supportive. | | **Tommy John** | Cool Cotton Boxers | Ultra‑soft, no‑pilling. | | **Lululemon** | Align Briefs | Seamless, breathable, great for yoga. | | **Patagonia** | Organic Cotton Boxers | Eco‑friendly, durable. | | **Saxx** | Underwear with Ball‑Park Pouch | Innovative support, comfortable. | --- ## Quick FAQ | Question | Answer | |----------|--------| | **Do I need a different pair for each day?** | Yes—daily wear should be changed to keep hygiene and prevent odor buildup. | | **Can I wear boxers under a suit?** | Yes, but choose a low‑cut, seamless pair to avoid visible lines. | | **What’s the best fabric for hot climates?** | Moisture‑wicking synthetics (polyester, nylon) or bamboo. | | **How do I know if a waistband is too tight?** | It should sit at the hips without pinching or leaving indentations after a few hours. | | **Can I wear compression shorts all day?** | They’re great for active days; for casual wear, a more breathable option is preferable. | --- ### Bottom Line - **Boxer briefs** are the all‑rounder: support + comfort. - **Briefs** are best for those who want maximum support and minimal bulk. - **Boxers** are ideal for lounging and casual wear. - **Trunks** offer a modern look with good support. - **Performance fabrics** are essential if you’re sweating a lot or in hot weather. Pick the style that matches your daily routine, body shape, and personal preference. And remember: the “best” underwear is the one that feels comfortable, fits well, and suits your lifestyle. Happy shopping!
